name: Gagan Gases Limited
about: Gagan Gases Limited engages in the bottling and selling of LPG for commercial and industrial use in the private sector and markets in India. The company operates LPG bottling plant at Pithampur, as well as provides assistance to Reliance and Aegis Gas. It is also involved in the filling of LPG cylinders, and sale of LPG in its own cylinder. Gagan Gases Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Indore, India.
